lead.en: A host-driven, read-only document and review cursor.
lead.zh: 由宿主驱动的只读文档与审核光标。

rule.en: The sample plays a successful edit. Choose Connection drops to test recovery. Retry keeps the original draft. No edits are saved. Optionally show a second cursor with with_collaborator(name, color). The cursor tag flips at the document edge.
rule.zh: 默认演示成功修改。可选择模拟断线，检查原文保留和重试过程。演示不保存修改。 用 with_collaborator(name, color) 显示第二个光标；标签到文档边缘会翻转。

api.en: Handle Run using its ticket with set_target_for, set_position_for, set_status_for and set_blocks_for; finish or fail the same ticket. Stop invalidates it and restores the original. Review exposes Accept and Undo events. set_position uses local logical pixels; set_visible controls off-screen work. Use select_target_for before a streamed replacement and with_meta for a byline. is_visible combines viewport and host visibility. Use set_activity_for to set the current action in the header and mark_correction_for to underline a UTF-8 byte range before replacing it. Both methods require the active Run ticket. Stop restores the draft and invalidates the ticket.
api.zh: 处理 Run 时使用 ticket 调用 set_target_for、set_position_for、set_status_for 和 set_blocks_for，再对同一 ticket 调用 finish 或 fail。Stop 使 ticket 失效并恢复原文。审核阶段提供 Accept 与 Undo 事件；set_position 使用文档内逻辑像素，set_visible 控制离屏工作。 select_target_for 在流式替换前选中文档块，with_meta 设置副标题，is_visible 返回视口和宿主共同决定的可见性。 用 set_activity_for 更新栏内的操作说明，mark_correction_for 在替换前给 UTF-8 字节范围加下划线。两者都需要当前 Run 的 ticket。停止会恢复原文并使 ticket 失效。

motion.en: The cursor tracks the measured selection endpoint. Newly written text fades in over 140 ms, and the review bar rises 8 px in 200 ms. Reduced motion shows the result without transitions.
motion.zh: 光标跟随实测的选区终点。新增文字用 140ms 淡入，审核条在 200ms 内上移 8px。减少动效时直接显示结果。
